# Add prepaid-credit top-up billing

Usage-based offerings need a `"topUp"` billing cycle backed by the existing customer wallet. The create and read contracts use string fields `topUpAmount` and optional `topUpThreshold`; the threshold defaults to `"0.2"`. A top-up amount is required for this billing cycle, top-up fields are invalid on other cycles, and subscription offerings cannot use it. Persist and return these fields without changing existing offering behavior.

Create one hourly scheduler per top-up offering. Enrollment and every hourly check must refill a wallet only when its balance is below `topUpThreshold * topUpAmount`, charging exactly the gap to `topUpAmount` through an invoice whose payment is stored as credit. Hourly usage must be deducted as a wallet transaction even when it exceeds the current balance; it must not generate a separate usage invoice. After the deduction, evaluate the refill using the updated balance. Preserve normal monthly and annual billing, invoice payment, and credit behavior.

Keep this behavior on the existing offering boundaries. A top-up offering must expose `topUp({ customer })`. Its hourly schedule must use `SupportedMeasurementFrequencies.everyHour`, carry `businessID` and `offeringId` in `scheduleParameters`, and use one stable offering-level `schedulerID` rather than a customer-specific ID. `topUp` must treat a balance exactly at the threshold as sufficient; below it, create one invoice with `storePaymentAsCredit: true` and one line item named `<offering name> - Top Up`, quantity `1`, and unit cost `topUpAmount - current balance`. The hourly path may use the existing `OfferingTopUpChecker` or the offering's billing flow, but it must record the full negative usage through `CreditService.create`, update the in-memory balance, and then call `topUp`. Zero usage still evaluates top-up but creates no credit transaction.

Verify with:

    cd /app && npm run build && npm run test:ci -- --runInBand

1665:     async determineStartTimeForInvoiceConsolidation({
1666:         customerId,
1667:         businessID,
1668:         billingCycleStartTime,
1669:     }: {
1670:         customerId: string;
1671:         businessID: string;
1672:         billingCycleStartTime: string;
1673:     }) {
1674:         const ledger = await this.customerService.getCustomerLedger({ customerId, businessID });
1675:         let startTime = billingCycleStartTime;
1676:         // Assumes that the ledger is sorted by date in descending order
1677:         if (ledger?.data) {
1678:             // Checks to see the last time a customer has had no offering associated with their account.
1679:             // If that time is before the start of the current billing cycle, then the start time is the start of the current billing cycle
1680:             // If that time is during the current billing cycle we use that start time.
1681:             // Prevents the case of a customer cancelling plans regularlly and then re-enrolling in the same billing cycle,
1682:             // which would cause the invoice to be consolidated with incorrect values
1683:             for (const item of ledger.data) {
1684:                 if (!item?.offeringId) {
1685:                     if (new Date(startTime).getTime() < new Date(item._time).getTime()) {
1686:                         startTime = item._time;
1687:                         break;
1688:                     } else {
1689:                         break;
1690:                     }
1691:                 }
1692:             }
1693:         }
1694:         return startTime;
1695:     }

341:         const [customerDBModels, settingsArr] = await Promise.all([
342:             this.InfluxService.getLatestCustomers({ businessID }),
343:             this.settingsService.findAll({ businessID }),
344:         ]);
345:         const entities = customerDBModels.map((dbModel) => CustomerEntity.dbModelToEntity(dbModel));
346:         const [settingsEntity] = settingsArr;
347:         const [readContractResponses, balances, customerIdInvoiceMap, children] = await Promise.all([
348:             this.contractService.findAll({
349:                 businessID,
350:                 customers: entities.filter((e) => e.offeringId),
351:             }),
352:             this.creditService.findAllCreditBalances({
353:                 businessID,
354:                 customerIds: entities.map((e) => e.customerId),
355:             }),
356:             this.invoicesService.findAllInvoicesForBusiness(businessID),
357:             this.customerGroupService.findAllChildRows({ businessID }),
358:         ]);
359: 
360:         const customerIdMap = readContractResponses.reduce(
361:             (acc, curr) => {
362:                 acc[`${curr.customerId}${curr.offeringId}`] = curr;
363:                 return acc;
364:             },
365:             {} as { [key: string]: ReadContractResponseDto },
366:         );
367:         let parentMap = {};
368:         let childrenMap = {};
369:         if (children?.data && children?.data.length > 0) {
370:             parentMap = children?.data.reduce((acc, child) => {
371:                 if (!acc[child.parentId]) {
372:                     acc[child.parentId] = [];
373:                 }
374:                 acc[child.parentId].push(child);
375:                 return acc;
376:             }, {});
377:             childrenMap = children?.data.reduce((acc, child) => {
378:                 acc[child.childId] = child;
379:                 return acc;
380:             }, {});
381:         }
382:         const customerWalletBalances = balances.reduce(
383:             (acc, item) => {
384:                 acc[item?.customerId] = item?.balance;
385:                 return acc;
386:             },
387:             {} as { [key: string]: string },
388:         );
389: 
390:         if (customerDBModels.length > 0) {
391:             const response = await Promise.all(
392:                 entities.map(async ({ customerId, ...rest }) => {
393:                     const invoiceEntities = customerIdInvoiceMap[customerId];
394:                     const children = parentMap[customerId];
395:                     const parent = childrenMap[customerId];
396:                     const invoices =
397:                         invoiceEntities?.length > 0
398:                             ? invoiceEntities.map((invoice) => new CustomerInvoiceMetadata(invoice))
399:                             : [];
400:                     let contract: ReadContractResponseDto[];
401:                     if (rest?.offeringIds) {
402:                         const ids = rest?.offeringIds;
403:                         contract = ids.map((offeringId) => {
404:                             const result = customerIdMap[`${customerId}${offeringId}`];
405:                             if (!result) {
406:                                 console.log(`Failed to find result`, result, customerId, offeringId, customerIdMap);
407:                                 return result;
408:                             } else {
409:                                 return result;
410:                             }
411:                         });
412:                     }
413: 
414:                     const res = await this.buildReadCustomerResponse({
415:                         customerConfig: [{ customerId, ...rest }],
416:                         customerId,
417:                         businessID,
418:                         getStripeInfo: false,
419:                         settingsEntity,
420:                         invoices,
421:                         contract,
422:                         balance: customerWalletBalances[customerId],
423:                         children,
424:                         parent,
425:                     });
426:                     return res?.data?.[0];
427:                 }),
428:             );
429:             CustomerService.logger.debug(`Found ${response.length} customers for ${businessID}`);
430:             return {
431:                 data: response,
432:                 message: 'Found Customers',
433:             };
434:         } else {
435:             return { data: [], message: 'No Customers Found' };
436:         }

554:     private async buildReadCustomerResponse({
555:         customerConfig,
556:         customerId,
557:         businessID,
558:         getStripeInfo = true,
559:         settingsEntity,
560:         invoices,
561:         contract,
562:         balance,
563:         children,
564:         parent,
565:     }: {
566:         customerConfig: CustomerInfluxRow[] | CustomerEntity[];
567:         customerId: string;
568:         businessID: string;
569:         getStripeInfo?: boolean;
570:         settingsEntity: ReadSettingsResponseData;
571:         invoices: CustomerInvoiceMetadata[];
572:         contract?: ReadContractResponseDto | ReadContractResponseDto[];
573:         balance?: string;
574:         children?: ReadChildRowResponseData[];
575:         parent?: ReadChildRowResponseData;
576:     }): Promise<CustomerReadResponse> {
577:         if (customerConfig.length > 0) {
578:             let entity: CustomerEntity;
579:             //eslint-disable-next-line
580:             // @ts-ignore
581:             if (customerConfig[0]?._measurement === undefined) {
582:                 entity = customerConfig[0] as CustomerEntity;
583:             } else {
584:                 entity = CustomerEntity.dbModelToEntity(customerConfig[0] as CustomerInfluxRow);
585:             }
586: 
587:             // enrich with customer wallet
588:             let customerWalletBalance = balance;
589:             if (!customerWalletBalance) {
590:                 const { balance: foundBalance } = await this.creditService.findCreditBalance({
591:                     businessID,
592:                     customerId,
593:                 });
594:                 customerWalletBalance = foundBalance;
595:             }
596:             // enrich with payment information
597:             const paymentChannel = entity?.paymentChannel;
598:             const stripeCustomerId = entity?.paymentChannelOptions?.stripeCustomerId;
599:             let stripeAccountReady = undefined;
600:             if (paymentChannel === PaymentChannel.Stripe && stripeCustomerId && getStripeInfo) {
601:                 const { stripeAccountId: businessStripeAccount, accountState } = settingsEntity;
602:                 if (businessStripeAccount) {
603:                     try {
604:                         const customerObj = await CustomerEntity.getStripeCustomer(
605:                             stripeCustomerId,
606:                             businessStripeAccount,
607:                             accountState,
608:                         );
609:                         if (customerObj) {
610:                             stripeAccountReady = await CustomerEntity.stripeCustomerPaymentInfoComplete(customerObj);
611:                         } else {
612:                             stripeAccountReady = false;
613:                         }
614:                     } catch (e) {
615:                         CustomerService.logger.warn(e.statusCode === 404 ? 'Stripe customer not found' : e.message);
616:                         stripeAccountReady = false;
617:                     }
618:                 }
619:             }
620:             let responseData: ReadCustomerResponseData[];
621:             if (contract && Array.isArray(contract)) {
622:                 responseData = [
623:                     new ReadCustomerResponseData(
624:                         {
625:                             ...entity,
626:                             creditBalance: customerWalletBalance,
627:                             freeTrialEndDate: contract[0]?.overridesForOffering?.freeTrialEndDate,
628:                         },
629:                         invoices,
630:                         contract,
631:                         stripeAccountReady,
632:                         children,
633:                         parent,
634:                     ),
635:                 ];
636:             } else {
637:                 responseData = [
638:                     new ReadCustomerResponseData(
639:                         {
640:                             ...entity,
641:                             freeTrialEndDate: (contract as ReadContractResponseDto)?.overridesForOffering
642:                                 ?.freeTrialEndDate,
643:                             creditBalance: customerWalletBalance,
644:                         },
645:                         invoices,
646:                         contract,
647:                         stripeAccountReady,
648:                         children,
649:                         parent,
650:                     ),
651:                 ];
652:             }
653:             return {
654:                 data: responseData,
655:                 message: 'Found Customer',
656:             };
657:         } else {
658:             throw new NotFoundException(`Customer with ID: ${customerId} not found`);
659:         }
660:     }

662:     async remove({ customerId, businessID }): Promise<DeleteCustomerResponseDto> {
663:         CustomerService.logger.log(`Attempting to delete customerId: ${customerId} for ${businessID}`);
664:         const customerConfig = await this.InfluxService.getLatestCustomer({ businessID, customerId });
665:         if (customerConfig.length === 0) {
666:             throw new NotFoundException(`Customer with ID: ${customerId} not found`);
667:         } else {
668:             const children = await this.customerGroupService.findAllChildRowsForParent({
669:                 parentId: customerId,
670:                 businessID,
671:             });
672:             if (children?.data?.length > 0) {
673:                 throw new BadRequestException(
674:                     `Failed to delete customer. Customer has children. Remove children before deleting customer.`,
675:                 );
676:             }
677:             const { loadPoints } = this.InfluxService;
678:             const entity = CustomerEntity.dbModelToEntity(customerConfig[0]);
679:             const { offeringId } = entity;
680:             entity.softDelete = true;
681:             entity.businessID = businessID;
682:             const points = CustomerEntity.transformer(entity, this.InfluxService);
683:             CustomerService.logger.log('Points to delete', points);
684:             if (offeringId) {
685:                 try {
686:                     const {
687:                         data: [oldOfferingConfig],
688:                     } = await this.offeringService.findOne({ businessID, offeringId });
689:                     const [settingsEntity] = await this.settingsService.findAll({ businessID });
690:                     const oldOffering = Offering.getInstance(
691:                         oldOfferingConfig,
692:                         customerId,
693:                         businessID,
694:                         this.invoicesService,
695:                         settingsEntity,
696:                         this.schedulerService,
697:                         this,
698:                         entity?.freeTrialEndDate,
699:                     );
700:                     await oldOffering.unenroll({
701:                         customer: { ...entity, offering: oldOfferingConfig, children: [] },
702:                     });
703:                 } catch (e) {
704:                     if (e instanceof NotFoundException) {
705:                         CustomerService.logger.warn(
706:                             `Failed to unenroll customer ${customerId} from offering ${offeringId}`,
707:                         );
708:                     } else {
709:                         throw e;
710:                     }
711:                 }
712:             }
713:             await loadPoints(`${process.env.STAGE}-config`, process.env.INFLUX_ORG, points);
714:         }
715:         return { message: 'Deleted Customer', customerId };
716:     }

718:     async update(
719:         { businessID, removePriorOffering = true, ...updatedFields }: UpdateCustomerDto,
720:         sub: string,
721:         customerId: string,
722:         overridesForCustomer?: CustomOverrides,
723:         usage?: UsageForCustomerEnrollment[],
724:     ): Promise<UpdateCustomerResponseDto> {
725:         CustomerService.logger.log(`Attempting to update saasClientID: ${customerId} for ${businessID}`);
726:         const {
727:             data: [{ ...rest }],
728:         } = await this.findOne({ customerId, businessID });
729:         const { loadPoints } = this.InfluxService;
730:         let freeTrialEndDate;
731:         let freeTrialStartDate;
732: 
733:         const { balance } = await this.creditService.findCreditBalance({ businessID, customerId });
734:         if (updatedFields?.currency && updatedFields?.currency !== rest?.currency) {
735:             if (parseFloat(balance) !== 0) {
736:                 throw new BadRequestException(
737:                     `Customer must not have a balance in order to change currency. Update the balance from: ${balance}`,
738:                 );
739:             }
740:         }
741:         let creditAmount = balance;
742: 
743:         const oldCustomerPaymentChannel = rest?.paymentChannel;
744:         const newCustomerPaymentChannel = updatedFields?.paymentChannel
745:             ? updatedFields?.paymentChannel
746:             : oldCustomerPaymentChannel;
747:         const shouldCreateStripeCustomer = CustomerEntity.shouldCreateStripeCustomer({
748:             oldCustomerPaymentChannel,
749:             newCustomerPaymentChannel,
750:             newPaymentChannelOptions: updatedFields?.paymentChannelOptions,
751:         });
752:         let settingsEntity;
753:         let businessStripeAccount;
754: 
755:         if (shouldCreateStripeCustomer) {
756:             [settingsEntity] = await this.settingsService.findAll({ businessID });
757:             ({ stripeAccountId: businessStripeAccount } = settingsEntity);
758:             if (!businessStripeAccount || businessStripeAccount === '') {
759:                 throw new BadRequestException(
760:                     `Failed to update customer. Must enable Stripe Connect in order to automatically add customer to Stripe.`,
761:                 );
762:             }
763:         }
764:         let newOfferingEnrollmentDate;
765: 
766:         CustomerService.logger.log('Updated fields', updatedFields);
767:         CustomerService.logger.log(
768:             `Comparision Check: ${
769:                 (updatedFields?.offeringId || updatedFields?.offeringId === null) &&
770:                 updatedFields?.offeringId !== rest?.offeringId
771:             }`,
772:         );
773:         if (updatedFields?.unenrollOffering) {
774:             await this.contractService.changeCustomerContract({
775:                 customer: rest,
776:                 subject: sub,
777:                 businessID,
778:                 unenrollOfferingId: updatedFields?.unenrollOffering,
779:             });
780:         }
781:         if (rest?.offeringIds && rest?.offeringIds.length >= 1) {
782:             if (updatedFields?.offeringId && !overridesForCustomer) {
783:                 const found = rest.offeringIds.find((offeringId) => offeringId === updatedFields?.offeringId);
784:                 if (found) {
785:                     throw new BadRequestException(
786:                         `Customer is already enrolled in offering ${updatedFields?.offeringId}`,
787:                     );
788:                 }
789:             }
790:         }
791:         if (
792:             (updatedFields?.offeringId || updatedFields?.offeringId === null) &&
793:             updatedFields?.offeringId !== rest?.offeringId
794:         ) {
795:             const {
796:                 freeTrialEndDate: newFreeTrialEndDate,
797:                 freeTrialStartDate: contractFreeTrialStartDate,
798:                 offeringEnrollmentDate,
799:                 prepaidCredit,
800:             } = await this.contractService.changeCustomerContract({
801:                 oldOfferingIds: rest?.offeringIds,
802:                 newOfferingId: updatedFields?.offeringId,
803:                 customer: rest,
804:                 subject: sub,
805:                 businessID,
806:                 overridesForCustomer,
807:                 usageOverrides: usage,
808:                 removePriorOffering,
809:             });
810:             freeTrialEndDate = newFreeTrialEndDate;
811:             newOfferingEnrollmentDate = offeringEnrollmentDate;
812:             freeTrialStartDate = contractFreeTrialStartDate;
813:             if (prepaidCredit) {
814:                 creditAmount = (parseFloat(creditAmount) + parseFloat(prepaidCredit)).toFixed(2).toString();
815:             }
816:         } else if (rest?.freeTrialEndDate) {
817:             freeTrialEndDate = rest?.freeTrialEndDate;
818:         }
819:         CustomerService.logger.log(
820:             `Comparision Check second If: ${
821:                 updatedFields?.offeringId !== null &&
822:                 updatedFields?.offeringId === rest?.offeringId &&
823:                 rest?.offeringId &&
824:                 overridesForCustomer
825:             } `,
826:         );
827:         if (
828:             updatedFields?.offeringId !== null &&
829:             (updatedFields?.offeringId === rest?.offeringId || updatedFields?.offeringId === undefined) &&
830:             rest?.offeringId &&
831:             overridesForCustomer
832:         ) {
833:             await this.contractService.update({
834:                 businessID,
835:                 offeringId: rest?.offeringId,
836:                 customerId,
837:                 overridesForOffering: overridesForCustomer,
838:             });
839:         }
840: 
841:         // break shouldCreateStripeCustomer into two parts because
842:         // 1. the 1st part is validating the input of the request
843:         // 2. the 2nd part below involves external calls which will create new entities in SaaS
844:         // business Stripe account. So we want to do internal processing of
845:         // offering first, making sure there is potential errors,
846:         // then call Stripe.
847:         let updatedStripeCustomerId;
848:         let portalUrl;
849:         if (shouldCreateStripeCustomer) {
850:             const { accountState } = settingsEntity;
851:             const results = await CustomerEntity.createStripeCustomer({
852:                 customerName: updatedFields?.customerName ? updatedFields?.customerName : rest?.customerName,
853:                 email: updatedFields?.email ? updatedFields?.email : rest?.email,
854:                 businessStripeAccount,
855:                 accountState,
856:             });
857:             updatedStripeCustomerId = results.stripeCustomerId;
858:             portalUrl = results.portalUrl;
859:         }
860: 
861:         const stripeCustomerId = shouldCreateStripeCustomer
862:             ? updatedStripeCustomerId
863:             : updatedFields?.paymentChannelOptions?.stripeCustomerId || rest?.paymentChannelOptions?.stripeCustomerId;
864: 
865:         CustomerService.logger.log(
866:             `Customer updatedFields Offering: ${updatedFields?.offeringId} Customer current offering: ${rest?.offeringId}`,
867:         );
868:         let removedOfferings = [];
869: 
870:         if (updatedFields?.unenrollOffering) {
871:             removedOfferings.push(updatedFields?.unenrollOffering);
872:         }
873:         if (updatedFields?.offeringId === null && rest?.offeringIds) {
874:             removedOfferings = removedOfferings.concat(rest?.offeringIds);
875:         }
876: 
877:         if (
878:             removePriorOffering &&
879:             updatedFields?.offeringId !== null &&
880:             updatedFields?.offeringId &&
881:             rest?.offeringIds &&
882:             !updatedFields?.unenrollOffering
883:         ) {
884:             removedOfferings = removedOfferings.concat(rest?.offeringIds);
885:         }
886:         const offeringIds = CustomerEntity.determineOfferingIdsArray({
887:             oldOfferingIds: rest?.offeringIds,
888:             newOfferingId: updatedFields?.offeringId,
889:             removedOfferings,
890:         });
891:         const customerEntity = new CustomerEntity({
892:             ...rest,
893: 
894:             ...updatedFields,
895:             offeringIds,
896:             offeringId: offeringIds ? offeringIds[0] : undefined,
897:             freeTrialEndDate,
898:             freeTrialStartDate:
899:                 !rest?.freeTrialStartDate && freeTrialEndDate ? freeTrialStartDate : rest?.freeTrialStartDate,
900:             customerId,
901:             businessID,
902:             creditBalance: creditAmount,
903:             paymentChannelOptions: stripeCustomerId ? { stripeCustomerId: stripeCustomerId } : undefined,
904:             offeringEnrollmentDate: newOfferingEnrollmentDate
905:                 ? newOfferingEnrollmentDate
906:                 : rest?.offeringEnrollmentDate,
907:             metadata: joinMetadataObjectsAndRemoveNulls(rest?.metadata, updatedFields?.metadata),
908:         });
909:         CustomerService.logger.log('Customer Entity Offering ID', customerEntity.offeringId);
910:         const points = CustomerEntity.transformer(customerEntity, this.InfluxService);
911:         CustomerService.logger.debug(`Updating customer ${customerId} in business ${businessID}.`);
912: 
913:         await loadPoints(`${process.env.STAGE}-config`, process.env.INFLUX_ORG, points);
914:         WebhookPublishingService.publishEvent({
915:             topic: WebhookProcessorEventType.Standard,
916:             type: WebhookType.CUSTOMER_UPDATED,
917:             data: [new ReadCustomerResponseData(customerEntity)],
918:             businessID,
919:         });
920:         return { message: 'Customer updated added', customerId: customerId, portalUrl };
921:     }
